Type: sofa
Name: Pinzon Capitola Double-Chaise Sectional Sofa with 8 Pillows
Colors: Natural
Materials: Wood
Double chaise sectional sofa in versatile tones with 8 included throw pillows Hardwood frame; foam cushions; coil springs for comfort; hand crafted in the USA 100-percent-cotton fabric needs only spot cleaning; seat cushions are 6 inches thick Left and right sections each measure 36 inches high by 63 wide by 30 inches deep Center section measures 36 inches high by 36 inches wide by 30 inches deep
